register.q: How do I create an account?
register.a:
You don’t need to sign up to chat — but an account reserves your nickname and keeps your avatar, 2FA and settings.
  1. First, enter with the nickname you want to keep.
  2. Open Settings (⚙, bottom left) → Account tab.
  3. Choose “Create an account”, enter your email and a password.
  4. Enter the code sent by email — your nickname is protected ✅

forgot.a:
If you’re still logged in to your account, change it in Settings → Account → Security.
Otherwise, ask a moderator in the channel for help, or via {{site}} — email reset is coming soon.

free.a: Yes, completely. No payment, no ads. {{name}} is an open service.

noaccount.q: Do I have to sign up?
noaccount.a: No. Pick a nickname and you’re in the channel. An account is optional: it’s there to protect your identity.

taken.a: A protected nickname belongs to an account. If it’s yours, click “Already have an account?” to identify. Otherwise, pick another one.

privacy.a: The connection is encrypted (TLS) and there’s no data resale. Private messages travel only between you and the other person.

mobile.a: Yes — it’s an installable app (PWA). From your browser, “Add to Home Screen” and you get it like a real app, notifications included.

what.a: A live chat built on the open IRCv3 protocol and powered by Orbit, a free web client.

bouncer.q: Can I connect through a bouncer (ZNC)?
bouncer.a: Yes. Click “Sign in via a bouncer”, enter your nickname (that’s the username) and your BNC password. Leave channels empty to reattach to the ones already open.
